own_solution.law: Reversible adiabatic of an ideal gas: T2 = T1 r^(gamma-1); W_on = n Cv (T2 - T1) = n R T1 (r^(gamma-1) - 1)/(gamma - 1)

T75C2.regime: the stop matters only if the required compression ratio exceeds 15; the stated ratio 8 is below it

T6655.regime: the stop matters only if the required compression ratio exceeds 15; the stated ratio 8 is below it

notes: nRT1/(gamma-1) = 1247.1/0.4 = 3117.75 J; times (2.297397 - 1) = 4044.96 J. With 1.8 mol: 3.6 x 4044.96 = 14561.85 J. The initial volume fixes p1 = nRT1/V1 and enters V2 = V1/8 and p1V1 terms but cancels from W, which depends only on n, T1, r, gamma. Volume sentences T6088 and T226E are wording variants with the same 17 L; the stop sentences T75C2 and T6655 share 15. The 'small amount' sentences carry no number, unlike their 1.3 mol counterparts; all of them are disconnected.
